name: Permission (Venue / Room)
description: Official request to the HoD or another authority for permission to conduct an event or use a venue such as a seminar hall or classroom

fields.label: Submitted to
fields.question: Who is this letter submitted to? (for example: HoD (CSE Dept.))

fields.label: Event name
fields.question: What is the name of the event?

fields.label: Venue
fields.question: Which venue do you need? (for example: Seminar Hall 402, CSE Department)

fields.label: Event date
fields.question: On which date is the event?

fields.label: Start time
fields.question: What time does the event start? (for example: 06:00 PM)

fields.label: End time
fields.question: What time does the event end?

fields.label: Brief description
fields.question: Give a short description of the event, or use the AI draft button.

fields.label: Objective
fields.question: What is the objective of the event?

fields.label: Number of participants
fields.question: How many participants are expected? (for example: 150+)

fields.label: Mode
fields.question: Will the event be Offline, Online or Hybrid?

fields.label: Event organizers
fields.question: Who are the event organisers? (for example: ACM Core 2026-27)

fields.label: Tech assistant: name
fields.question: What is the name of the tech assistant of the venue?

fields.label: Tech assistant: designation
fields.question: What is the tech assistant's designation? (for example: Tech Assistant, Seminar Hall)

fields.label: Faculty in-charge: name
fields.question: What is the name of the faculty in-charge of the venue?

fields.label: Faculty in-charge: designation
fields.question: What is the faculty in-charge's designation? (for example: Faculty in-charge, Seminar Hall)

name: Prize Money Receipt
description: Receipt signed by a competition winner acknowledging prize money, with the winner's bank account details, recommended for payment by the chairman

fields.label: Event / competition name
fields.question: What is the name of the competition or event?

fields.label: Event date
fields.question: On which date was the event held?

fields.label: Venue
fields.question: Where was the event held?

fields.label: Winner's name
fields.question: What is the winner's name?

fields.label: Roll no.
fields.question: What is the winner's roll number?

fields.label: Course & semester
fields.question: Which course and semester is the winner in? (for example: B.Tech CSE, Sem 5)

fields.label: Mobile no.
fields.question: What is the winner's mobile number?

fields.label: Position
fields.question: Which position did the winner secure? (for example: 1st, 2nd, 3rd)

fields.label: Prize amount (Rs.)
fields.question: What is the prize amount in rupees?

fields.label: Name as per bank account
fields.question: What is the name as per the bank account?

fields.label: Bank name
fields.question: Which bank is the account in?

fields.label: Branch
fields.question: Which branch is the account in?

fields.label: Account no.
fields.question: What is the bank account number?

fields.label: IFSC code
fields.question: What is the IFSC code?

fields.label: PAN card no.
fields.question: What is the PAN card number?

name: Invitation Notice
description: Notice or invitation announcing an event to students

name: Budget Request
description: Request for funds listing expected expenses for an event
